title: Discrete Impulse
text: Generate discrete impulse, 1 output, no direct feedthrough, {Mode} sets Data type mode; {Delay (samples)} sets the number of zero-valued output samples, {Sample time} sets the output sample period, {Samples per frame}, {Output data type}, {Signedness}, {Scaling} sets the method for scaling fixed-point data Best, {Word length} sets the bit size of the word that holds the quantized, {Fraction length} and {Data type override}. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Port_1
ports.summary: Discrete impulse signal scalar | vector | matrix

params.name: Delay (samples)
params.values: Number of zero-valued output samples 0 (default) | scalar | vector

params.name: Output data type
params.values: Output data type double (default) | single | int8 | uint8 | int16 | uint16 | int32 | uint32 | int64 | uint64 | boolean | fixdt(1,16) | fixdt(1,16,0) | Inherit: Inherit via back propagation |

params.name: Mode
params.values: Data type mode Inherit (default) | Built in | Fixed point | Expression

params.name: Signedness
params.values: Signedness of fixed-point data Signed (default) | Unsigned

params.name: Scaling
params.values: Method for scaling fixed-point data Best precision (default) | Binary point

params.name: Word length
params.values: Bit size of the word that holds the quantized integer 16 (default) | integer from 2 to 128

params.name: Fraction length
params.values: Fraction length for fixed-point data type 0 (default) | integer scalar

params.name: Data type override
params.values: Data type override mode Inherit (default) | Off
